_comment: Pre-recorded human reviews for the SYNTHETIC fixture corpus only.
These are not live markets. The ids below name fixture files in this directory, and
the review recorded against each one is a statement about those synthetic contracts.
event_arb.demo_reviews refuses to load this file unless the data source is fixtures,
so nothing here can ever be replayed against a real market.
Adding an entry here is the same commitment as approving in the dashboard: you are
asserting you read both rulebooks and that the two contracts settle identically off
the same authority. Do not add a pair you have not read.

reviews.notes: Synthetic fixture pair. Both legs were written to settle off the same FOMC statement, with identical thresholds and direction, for the acceptance test.
Synthetic fixture pair for the Global corpus, written to mirror the US entry above.
